title: who-first: Priority reading carried as 'confirmed'
description: 'Calif found the flaws first' is an attribution of priority, a reading. The Foundation's capture says the same root cause was 'the OOM problem we had found in 2024' and that 'OpenAI independently reported the same root cause on the same day'. The 1 August discovery date is Calif's own claim. Use status 'reported', or narrow it to 'Calif has the earliest public timestamp (hash on 5 August) of the 2026 reporters'.
